research.name: Hazelnut
research.note: Terminal file organizer that watches folders and applies TOML rules, with a 15-theme picker showing color swatches per theme.

effects: theme picker overlay listing 15 themes with inline color swatches per theme
two-tone block-letter logo banner on the dashboard
Hazel-style folder watch rules managed from a tabbed TUI with a background daemon
